author: jojobloblo
body:
Hey everyone! I'm pretty new at mapmaking and I figured I'd just give it a try, so here is my first map. Since I am new, it's probably pretty bad, so I am open to all positive and negative feedback in any way, shape, or form. I'm open to all suggestions and will do my best to make the map suitable for gameplay and you, the player's, enjoyment.

Here are the images: http://imgur.com/15pomMM,fHw5UQl,a7NhelX,k6wHZVd,PU3l0op,Gpm14ES,JKD1SrR,p4NsUHK,Alq961R,JuCLcCm,5Pj...

And here is the link if you would like to check it out yourself: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/5jm6dtvwvtfevt5/AADC44Y9xNSvErdfoIotMBYea?dl=0

PS I've never used dropbox before so I doubt it will work just let me know what I need to change xD
